nearest_gate: Bounded belief/search treatment capability and exact tactical teacher for causal cardplay experiments

contract.scope: Suit, Grand, Null basic contracts; complete three-hand perfect information; at most three cards per original seat including a partial trick
contract.objective: Additional declarer trick points in Suit/Grand; negative future declarer trick count in Null
contract.opposition: Two defenders jointly minimize declarer utility
contract.output: Exact best legal card, each root action value, deterministic input hash, states visited

invariants: Requires all hidden hands; offline teacher only
No deployment inference path or hidden-card leakage into decision-time input
No B0 or R9 process changed
limits: No strength estimate, treatment decision, or training approval
Perfect-information values are not legal observations and must not be presented to a deployed policy as inputs
Three-card bound is intentionally tactical and does not solve full Skat
Teacher usefulness requires a split-safe bounded ablation and deployment-valid paired gameplay
next_gate: Generate identified train-only endgame cases when exact qualified data is accessible; evaluate a bounded distilled/search treatment against frozen B0 with the paired gameplay gate.
